{{Quote|Well, all right, then. Come back soon. We appreciate your patronage.|Unidentified Bartender to Ton Phanan|<ref name="if" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bartender/Legends|'''bartender''']] worked at [[Rojio's]], a bar on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hullis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].<ref name="if" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wait, where do I sign?"<br />"Why would you want to sign?''"<br />"''So I can put in a claim for damages!|Unidentified bartender and a Stormtrooper|<ref name="if" />}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]'' to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] carried out a [[Halmad campaign|mission]] to steal [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] from [[Victory Base]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].<ref name="if" />

It began with Wraiths [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Ton Phanan]] starting a fight with a group of Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were drinking in the bar. The bartender pleaded for them to stop but was ignored; he then contacted the local military police via his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="if" />

When [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] arrived at the location, they arrested everyone involved in the fight. Phanan offered to pay for the damages incurred during the fight, much to the bartender's relief.<ref name="if" />
